task.description: User-requested batch recheck of GitHub issues GH-280 through GH-301 (mostly infrastructure/process issues), on the suspicion that several are stale given the volume of work merged since filing. Verify each against current repo state and real test runs where feasible, then close/comment/defer with evidence — no speculative closes.
acceptance_criteria: Every issue in the range gets a verdict backed by source evidence or a real test run
Confirmed-fixed issues are closed on GitHub with evidence quoted
Still-open issues get an evidence comment reflecting current (not stale) state
Any new defect discovered during verification is filed as its own issue and queued, not folded into this run
Any issue requiring a scoping/design decision gets that decision recorded, not another silent defer

result.summary: Dispatched a read-only verification subagent across all 20 issues (GH-280..301). Findings: 7 CONFIRMED_FIXED (GH-282,284,286,287,288 direct; GH-296 substantially resolved; GH-298 superseded by current global-queue architecture) — all closed on GitHub with evidence, corresponding docs/issues/ISS-*.json updated to RESOLVED. 2 CLOSED already (GH-285,289,290) — no action needed. 9 STILL_OPEN/NOT_DONE (GH-280,281,283,291,292,293,294,295,297,299,300) — each given a fresh evidence comment correcting or confirming the original 2026-07-29 triage note; GH-280 and GH-283's original triage notes were found to be materially wrong (GH-280 cited coverage that doesn't exist under the exact filename the issue names; GH-283 cited the wrong release-decision file entirely) and are now corrected on the issue. GH-281 reclassified as needing a scope decision (intended-skip vs. hard-fail), not further diagnosis. GH-301 (GOV-02) resolved as a scoping decision: add depends_on as an optional/additive field, not mandatory backfill — recorded on the issue and the queue entry, deferred cleanly (not re-claimed ambiguously as it was twice before). One new defect discovered during verification (aggregate zig build test-integration instability blocking a clean signal on GH-283) filed as ISS-0658 / GH-679 and added to the global queue, per Unblock-Everything's incidental-discovery carve-out (not fixed inline).
